newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria has 20.6 bln levs proceeds from sell-offs.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria has 20.6 bln levs proceeds from sell-offs.

text.p: Bulgaria received 20.6 billion levs from 1,284 privatisation deals sealed since the beginning of this year, a Privatisation Agency official said on Thursday.
"Direct revenue from sell-off contracts from the beginning of the year until September 6 totals 20.586 billion levs," a Privatisation Agency press official told Reuters.
Under the contracts the new owners also pledged to pay some 40 billion levs of companies' debts and invest 8.2 billion levs this year alone, the official said.

Major deals included the sale of the Sheraton Sofia Hotel Balkan to South Korea's giant Daewoo Corp for $22.3 million and the electric tool maker Eltos to the German-registered Sparky Trading GmbH for 11.5 million German marks.
Those sales were among 19 privatisation deals for a total of $42 million, approved by the government last week.

The cabinet also gave a green light for the sale of a 75 percent stake in the contry's second biggest oil refinery Plama, intitially slated for liquidation, to Bulgaria's Euroenergy holding for 62 million levs.
International lending institutions have urged Bulgaria's socialist cabinet to speed up privatisation as revenue from sell-offs is seen a major cash source for the debt-ridden state.
Last week the International Monetary Fund postponed crucial funding for Bulgaria until the government closes heavily indebted state-owned firms or sells them.
